statement: -- ============================================================================
-- ClassTrack · 0003 Row Level Security + grants + realtime publication
-- Boundary rules:
--   * Every tenant table is filtered by current_institution_id().
--   * Teachers only manage classes/modules/sessions they own or teach.
--   * Teacher private fields live in separate tables (owner + admin only).
--   * Students can READ their own attendance, never WRITE it (no policy, no grant).
--   * QR token tables have no client policies at all: RPCs + service role only.
-- ============================================================================
-- ============================================================================
-- ClassTrack · 0001 Core relational schema
-- Target: Supabase Postgres 15+
-- Scope: institutions, people, modules/classes, weekly schedules, sessions,
--        attendance, QR tokens, audit/history, reporting views.
-- Supersedes docs/03-database-schema.sql (which used 20s QR tokens / "excused").
-- ============================================================================

set local search_path = public, extensions;

create schema if not exists extensions;
create extension if not exists pgcrypto with schema extensions;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enums
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create type public.user_role         as enum ('teacher', 'admin', 'student');
create type public.profile_status    as enum ('invited', 'active', 'suspended');
create type public.attendance_status as enum ('present', 'late', 'absent', 'justified');
create type public.attendance_source as enum ('qr', 'teacher', 'auto', 'admin_correction', 'import');
create type public.session_status    as enum ('scheduled', 'live', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'rescheduled');
create type public.change_type       as enum ('cancelled', 'rescheduled', 'time_changed', 'room_changed');
create type public.risk_level        as enum ('healthy', 'watch', 'at_risk', 'critical');
create type public.import_kind       as enum ('students_csv', 'students_xlsx', 'timetable_image', 'timetable_text');
create type public.import_status     as enum ('staged', 'review', 'committed', 'failed');
create type public.notification_kind as enum ('session', 'attendance', 'risk', 'import', 'report', 'invite', 'system');

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pure domain helper: weighted attendance rate
-- rate = (present + 0.5 * late) / (present + late + absent); justified excluded.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.attendance_rate(
  p_present int, p_late int, p_absent int
) returns numeric
language sql immutable parallel safe
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select case
    when coalesce(p_present, 0) + coalesce(p_late, 0) + coalesce(p_absent, 0) = 0 then null
    else round(
      (
        (coalesce(p_present, 0) + 0.5 * coalesce(p_late, 0))::numeric
        / (coalesce(p_present, 0) + coalesce(p_late, 0) + coalesce(p_absent, 0))::numeric
      ) * 100,
      2
    )
  end;
$$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tenant root and academic calendar
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.institutions (
  id                          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name                        text not null,
  slug                        text not null unique,
  timezone                    text not null default 'Africa/Casablanca',
  -- Attendance windows (server-side authority; client clock is never trusted)
  checkin_opens_minutes_before int not null default 10  check (checkin_opens_minutes_before between 0 and 120),
  checkin_closes_minutes_after int not null default 15  check (checkin_closes_minutes_after between 1 and 240),
  late_after_minutes          int not null default 5    check (late_after_minutes between 0 and 240),
  -- QR policy. REQUIREMENT: temporary tokens live 4 seconds by default.
  qr_token_ttl_seconds        int not null default 4    check (qr_token_ttl_seconds between 1 and 60),
  attendance_edit_hours       int not null default 24   check (attendance_edit_hours between 0 and 720),
  risk_warning_pct            numeric(5,2) not null default 75.00 check (risk_warning_pct between 0 and 100),
  risk_critical_pct           numeric(5,2) not null default 60.00 check (risk_critical_pct between 0 and 100),
  created_at                  timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at                  timestamptz not null default now(),
  deleted_at                  timestamptz,
  constraint risk_thresholds_ordered check (risk_critical_pct < risk_warning_pct)
);

create table public.departments (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  name           text not null,
  code           text not null,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  deleted_at     timestamptz,
  constraint departments_code_uq unique (institution_id, code),
  constraint departments_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id)
);

create table public.terms (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  name           text not null,
  starts_on      date not null,
  ends_on        date not null,
  is_active      boolean not null default false,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint terms_name_uq unique (institution_id, name),
  constraint terms_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint terms_dates_valid check (ends_on > starts_on)
);

create table public.holidays (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  name           text not null,
  holiday_date   date not null,
  constraint holidays_date_uq unique (institution_id, holiday_date)
);

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- People. Public directory fields live in profiles; private fields are split
-- out so teachers can never read another teacher's private data through RLS.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.profiles (
  id             uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  role           public.user_role not null,
  first_name     text not null,
  last_name      text not null,
  email          text not null,
  title          text,
  department_id  uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  avatar_url     text,
  status         public.profile_status not null default 'active',
  last_active_at timestamptz,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  deleted_at     timestamptz,
  constraint profiles_email_uq unique (institution_id, email),
  constraint profiles_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id)
);
create index profiles_institution_role_idx on public.profiles (institution_id, role) where deleted_at is null;
create index profiles_department_idx on public.profiles (department_id) where deleted_at is null;

create table public.teacher_private_details (
  teacher_id     uuid primary key references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  phone          text,
  office         text,
  employee_no    text,
  personal_email text,
  bio            text,
  updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint teacher_private_details_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, teacher_id)
);

create table public.teacher_private_notes (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id  uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  owner_teacher_id uuid not null references public.profiles(id) on delete cascade,
  entity_type     text not null check (entity_type in ('student', 'class', 'module', 'session')),
  entity_id       uuid not null,
  body            text not null,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now()
);
create index teacher_private_notes_owner_idx on public.teacher_private_notes (owner_teacher_id, created_at desc);

create table public.students (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  profile_id     uuid unique references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  student_number text not null,
  first_name     text not null,
  last_name      text not null,
  email          text not null,
  phone          text,
  program        text not null,
  year_level     int not null default 1 check (year_level between 1 and 8),
  risk_level     public.risk_level not null default 'healthy',
  search_tsv     tsvector generated always as (
                   to_tsvector('simple', coalesce(first_name, '') || ' ' || coalesce(last_name, '') || ' ' || student_number)
                 ) stored,
  deleted_at     timestamptz,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint students_number_uq unique (institution_id, student_number),
  constraint students_email_uq unique (institution_id, email),
  constraint students_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id)
);
create index students_search_idx on public.students using gin (search_tsv);
create index students_institution_idx on public.students (institution_id) where deleted_at is null;
create index students_risk_idx on public.students (institution_id, risk_level) where deleted_at is null;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Teaching model
-- MODULE  = subject owned by a teacher (what is taught).
-- CLASS   = cohort/group owned by a teacher (who is taught).
-- A student belongs to exactly one ACTIVE class (partial unique index below).
-- A teacher owns many modules and many classes; a module can be taught to
-- several classes; a class can receive several modules from different teachers.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.modules (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id  uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  term_id         uuid not null,
  department_id   uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  owner_teacher_id uuid not null,
  code            text not null,
  title           text not null,
  description     text,
  color           text not null default '#2563EB',
  is_archived     boolean not null default false,
  deleted_at      timestamptz,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint modules_code_uq unique (institution_id, term_id, code),
  constraint modules_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint modules_term_fk foreign key (institution_id, term_id) references public.terms(institution_id, id) on delete restrict,
  constraint modules_owner_fk foreign key (institution_id, owner_teacher_id) references public.profiles(institution_id, id) on delete restrict
);
create index modules_owner_idx on public.modules (owner_teacher_id) where deleted_at is null;

create table public.classes (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id    uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  term_id           uuid not null,
  teacher_id        uuid not null,
  department_id     uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  code              text not null,
  title             text not null,
  description       text,
  room              text,
  color             text not null default '#2563EB',
  expected_students int not null default 0 check (expected_students >= 0),
  is_archived       boolean not null default false,
  deleted_at        timestamptz,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint classes_code_uq unique (institution_id, term_id, code),
  constraint classes_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint classes_term_fk foreign key (institution_id, term_id) references public.terms(institution_id, id) on delete restrict,
  constraint classes_teacher_fk foreign key (institution_id, teacher_id) references public.profiles(institution_id, id) on delete restrict
);
create index classes_teacher_idx on public.classes (teacher_id) where deleted_at is null;
create index classes_term_idx on public.classes (term_id) where deleted_at is null;

create table public.class_modules (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  class_id       uuid not null,
  module_id      uuid not null,
  created_at     timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint class_modules_uq unique (class_id, module_id),
  constraint class_modules_id_class_uq unique (id, class_id),
  constraint class_modules_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint class_modules_class_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_id) references public.classes(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint class_modules_module_fk foreign key (institution_id, module_id) references public.modules(institution_id, id) on delete cascade
);
create index class_modules_module_idx on public.class_modules (module_id);

create table public.enrollments (
  id             uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  class_id       uuid not null,
  student_id     uuid not null,
  enrolled_at    timestamptz not null default now(),
  status         text not null default 'active' check (status in ('active', 'dropped', 'completed')),
  deleted_at     timestamptz,
  constraint enrollments_uq unique (class_id, student_id),
  constraint enrollments_class_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_id) references public.classes(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint enrollments_student_fk foreign key (institution_id, student_id) references public.students(institution_id, id) on delete cascade
);
-- REQUIREMENT: a student belongs to one class at a time.
create unique index enrollments_one_active_class_per_student_uq
  on public.enrollments (student_id)
  where status = 'active' and deleted_at is null;
create index enrollments_class_active_idx on public.enrollments (class_id) where status = 'active' and deleted_at is null;
create index enrollments_student_idx on public.enrollments (student_id);

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Weekly recurrence rules -> generated session occurrences
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.schedule_rules (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id  uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  class_id        uuid not null,
  class_module_id uuid not null,
  weekday         smallint not null check (weekday between 1 and 7),  -- ISO: 1=Mon
  starts_at_time  time not null,
  ends_at_time    time not null,
  room            text,
  valid_from      date not null,
  valid_until     date not null,
  is_active       boolean not null default true,
  created_by      uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint schedule_rules_time_valid check (ends_at_time > starts_at_time),
  constraint schedule_rules_window_valid check (valid_until >= valid_from),
  constraint schedule_rules_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint schedule_rules_class_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_id) references public.classes(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint schedule_rules_class_module_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_module_id) references public.class_modules(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  -- Guarantees the rule points at a module actually attached to its class.
  constraint schedule_rules_class_module_match_fk
    foreign key (class_module_id, class_id) references public.class_modules(id, class_id) on delete cascade
);
create index schedule_rules_lookup_idx on public.schedule_rules (class_id, weekday) where is_active;
create index schedule_rules_module_idx on public.schedule_rules (class_module_id);

create table public.sessions (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id    uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  class_id          uuid not null,
  class_module_id   uuid,                       -- null = ad-hoc session
  schedule_rule_id  uuid,                       -- null = ad-hoc / replacement
  teacher_id        uuid not null,               -- teacher who actually teaches it
  starts_at         timestamptz not null,
  ends_at           timestamptz not null,
  room              text,
  status            public.session_status not null default 'scheduled',
  qr_enabled        boolean not null default true,
  opened_at         timestamptz,
  closed_at         timestamptz,
  cancel_reason     text,
  rescheduled_to    uuid references public.sessions(id) on delete set null,
  notes             text,
  created_by        uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint sessions_time_valid check (ends_at > starts_at),
  constraint sessions_cancel_reason check (status <> 'cancelled' or cancel_reason is not null),
  constraint sessions_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  -- One occurrence per weekly rule slot: regeneration is idempotent.
  constraint sessions_generated_uq unique (schedule_rule_id, starts_at),
  constraint sessions_class_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_id) references public.classes(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint sessions_class_module_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_module_id) references public.class_modules(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint sessions_teacher_fk foreign key (institution_id, teacher_id) references public.profiles(institution_id, id) on delete restrict
);
create index sessions_class_time_idx on public.sessions (class_id, starts_at desc);
create index sessions_teacher_time_idx on public.sessions (teacher_id, starts_at desc);
create index sessions_institution_status_idx on public.sessions (institution_id, status, starts_at)
  where status in ('scheduled', 'live');

create table public.attendance (
  id                   uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id       uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  session_id           uuid not null,
  student_id           uuid not null,
  status               public.attendance_status not null,
  late_minutes         int,
  notes                text,                    -- private teacher note
  justification_reason text,
  justification_url    text,                     -- signed Storage path
  source               public.attendance_source not null default 'teacher',
  marked_by            uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  marked_at            timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at           timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint attendance_uq unique (session_id, student_id),
  constraint attendance_late_minutes check (late_minutes is null or status = 'late'),
  constraint attendance_late_requires_minutes check (status <> 'late' or late_minutes between 1 and 1440),
  constraint attendance_justified_requires_reason check (status <> 'justified' or justification_reason is not null),

-- Class and module owners must be real teacher profiles in the same institution.
-- Defence in depth for direct writes (including service-role imports).
create or replace function public.fn_require_teacher_owner()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_teacher_id uuid;
begin
  v_teacher_id := coalesce(
    (to_jsonb(new) ->> 'owner_teacher_id')::uuid,
    (to_jsonb(new) ->> 'teacher_id')::uuid
  );
  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = v_teacher_id
      and p.institution_id = new.institution_id
      and p.role = 'teacher'
      and p.deleted_at is null
  ) then
    raise exception 'teacher_owner_must_be_teacher' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

-- A session's teacher must be the owner of the module being taught.
create or replace function public.fn_validate_session_teacher()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_module_owner uuid;
begin
  if new.class_module_id is not null then
    select m.owner_teacher_id into v_module_owner
    from public.class_modules cm
    join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
    where cm.id = new.class_module_id;

    if v_module_owner is distinct from new.teacher_id then
      raise exception 'session_teacher_must_match_module_owner' using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

  before insert or update of teacher_id, class_module_id on public.sessions
  for each row execute function public.fn_validate_session_teacher();

  if v_status in ('cancelled', 'rescheduled') then

end $$;

-- Keep the denormalised risk flag current for dashboards/alerts.
create or replace function public.fn_refresh_student_risk(p_student_id uuid)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_inst uuid;
  v_warn numeric;
  v_crit numeric;
  v_rate numeric;
begin
  select institution_id into v_inst from public.students where id = p_student_id;
  if v_inst is null then return; end if;

  select risk_warning_pct, risk_critical_pct into v_warn, v_crit
  from public.institutions where id = v_inst;

  select public.attendance_rate(
    count(*) filter (where a.status = 'present')::int,
    count(*) filter (where a.status = 'late')::int,
    count(*) filter (where a.status = 'absent')::int
  ) into v_rate
  from public.attendance a
  join public.sessions s on s.id = a.session_id and s.status = 'completed'
  where a.student_id = p_student_id;

  update public.students
     set risk_level = case
       when v_rate is null then 'healthy'
       when v_rate < v_crit then 'critical'
       when v_rate < v_warn then 'at_risk'
       when v_rate < v_warn + 8 then 'watch'
       else 'healthy'
     end
   where id = p_student_id;
end $$;

create or replace function public.fn_attendance_refresh_risk()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  perform public.fn_refresh_student_risk(new.student_id);
  return new;
end $$;

  for each row execute function public.fn_attendance_refresh_risk();

-- Bootstrap-friendly: service role key and local migration role are admins.
-- Normal JWT users are never treated as admins unless their profile says so.
create or replace function public.is_admin()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select auth.role() = 'service_role'
      or session_user in ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
      or coalesce((
        select p.role = 'admin'
        from public.profiles p
        where p.id = auth.uid() and p.deleted_at is null
      ), false)
$$;

create or replace function public.is_teacher()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select coalesce(public.current_app_role() = 'teacher', false)
$$;

create or replace function public.is_student()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select coalesce(public.current_app_role() = 'student', false)
$$;

create or replace function public.can_manage_class(p_class_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
      and c.deleted_at is null
      and (public.is_admin() or (public.is_teacher() and c.teacher_id = auth.uid()))
  )
$$;

-- Full class access includes: owner, admin, module teacher, enrolled student.
create or replace function public.can_view_class(p_class_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
      and c.deleted_at is null
      and (
        public.is_admin()
        or (public.is_teacher() and c.teacher_id = auth.uid())
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.class_modules cm
          join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
          where cm.class_id = c.id
            and m.owner_teacher_id = auth.uid()
            and m.deleted_at is null
            and public.is_teacher()
        )
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.enrollments e
          join public.students st on st.id = e.student_id
          where e.class_id = c.id
            and st.profile_id = auth.uid()

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Weekly timetable -> concrete session occurrences
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_generate_sessions(
  p_class_id uuid,
  p_from date,
  p_to date,
  p_replace_future boolean default false
) returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_count int := 0;
begin
  if not (
    public.is_admin()
    or public.can_manage_class(p_class_id)
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.schedule_rules sr
      join public.class_modules cm on cm.id = sr.class_module_id
      join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
      where sr.class_id = p_class_id
        and m.owner_teacher_id = auth.uid()
        and public.is_teacher()
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to < p_from then
    raise exception 'invalid_date_range' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  -- Timetable edits may rebuild future, untouched occurrences only.
  if p_replace_future then
    delete from public.sessions s
     where s.class_id = p_class_id
       and s.starts_at > now()
       and s.status = 'scheduled'
       and s.schedule_rule_id is not null;
  end if;

  with slots as (
    select
      sr.id as rule_id,
      sr.institution_id,
      sr.class_id,
      sr.class_module_id,
      m.owner_teacher_id,
      (greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from) + g.n) as day,
      sr.starts_at_time,
      sr.ends_at_time,
      sr.room,
      i.timezone
    from public.schedule_rules sr
    join public.class_modules cm on cm.id = sr.class_module_id
    join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
    join public.institutions i on i.id = sr.institution_id
    cross join lateral generate_series(
      0,
      least(sr.valid_until, p_to) - greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from)
    ) as g(n)
    where sr.class_id = p_class_id
      and sr.is_active
      and extract(isodow from (greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from) + g.n)) = sr.weekday
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.holidays h
        where h.institution_id = sr.institution_id
          and h.holiday_date = (greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from) + g.n)
      )
  )
  insert into public.sessions
    (institution_id, class_id, class_module_id, schedule_rule_id, teacher_id,
     starts_at, ends_at, room, status, created_by)
  select
    institution_id, class_id, class_module_id, rule_id, owner_teacher_id,
    (day + starts_at_time) at time zone timezone,
    (day + ends_at_time) at time zone timezone,
    room, 'scheduled', auth.uid()
  from slots
  on conflict (schedule_rule_id, starts_at) do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Session lifecycle
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_start_session(p_session_id uuid)
returns public.sessions
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_session public.sessions;
begin
  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status <> 'scheduled' then raise exception 'invalid_session_state' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;

  update public.sessions
     set status = 'live', opened_at = coalesce(opened_at, now()), updated_at = now()
   where id = p_session_id
  returning * into v_session;

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'session.start', 'session', v_session.id,
          jsonb_build_object('status', 'live', 'opened_at', v_session.opened_at));
  return v_session;
end $$;

create or replace function public.rpc_close_session(p_session_id uuid)
returns public.sessions
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_session public.sessions;
begin
  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status <> 'live' then raise exception 'invalid_session_state' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;

  update public.sessions
     set status = 'completed', closed_at = now(), qr_enabled = false, updated_at = now()
   where id = p_session_id
  returning * into v_session;

  -- Unmarked students become absent. Justified/manual records are preserved.
  -- Status is set first so the risk refresh trigger sees a completed session.
  insert into public.attendance
    (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, source, marked_by)
  select v_session.institution_id, v_session.id, e.student_id, 'absent', 'auto', auth.uid()
  from public.enrollments e
  where e.class_id = v_session.class_id
    and e.status = 'active'
    and e.deleted_at is null
  on conflict (session_id, student_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'session.close', 'session', v_session.id,
          jsonb_build_object('status', 'completed', 'closed_at', v_session.closed_at));
  return v_session;
end $$;

create or replace function public.rpc_change_session(
  p_session_id uuid,
  p_change public.change_type,
  p_reason text,
  p_new_start timestamptz default null,
  p_new_end timestamptz default null,
  p_new_room text default null
) returns public.sessions
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_old public.sessions;
  v_new public.sessions;
begin
  if p_reason is null or btrim(p_reason) = '' then
    raise exception 'reason_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select * into v_old from public.sessions where id = p_session_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_old.status in ('completed', 'cancelled', 'rescheduled') then
    raise exception 'session_locked' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  if p_change = 'cancelled' then
    update public.sessions
       set status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = p_reason, qr_enabled = false, updated_at = now()
     where id = p_session_id
    returning * into v_new;
  else
    if p_new_start is null or p_new_end is null or p_new_end <= p_new_start then
      raise exception 'invalid_new_time' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;

    -- Replacement is deliberately NOT tied to a weekly rule: it is a one-off.
    insert into public.sessions
      (institution_id, class_id, class_module_id, teacher_id, starts_at, ends_at,
       room, status, created_by)
    values
      (v_old.institution_id, v_old.class_id, v_old.class_module_id, v_old.teacher_id,
       p_new_start, p_new_end, coalesce(p_new_room, v_old.room), 'scheduled', auth.uid())
    returning * into v_new;

    update public.sessions
       set status = 'rescheduled', rescheduled_to = v_new.id, cancel_reason = p_reason,
           qr_enabled = false, updated_at = now()
     where id = p_session_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.session_changes
    (institution_id, session_id, change, reason, previous, new_values, changed_by)
  values
    (v_old.institution_id, p_session_id, p_change, p_reason,
     jsonb_build_object('starts_at', v_old.starts_at, 'ends_at', v_old.ends_at, 'room', v_old.room),
     jsonb_build_object('new_session_id', v_new.id, 'starts_at', p_new_start,
                        'ends_at', p_new_end, 'room', coalesce(p_new_room, v_old.room)),
     auth.uid());

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_old.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'session.' || p_change::text, 'session', p_session_id,
          jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason, 'new_session_id', v_new.id));

  return v_new;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- QR tokens: 4-second lifetime, hash at rest, no client read access.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_issue_qr_token(p_session_id uuid)
returns table (token text, expires_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_session public.sessions;
  v_inst public.institutions;
  v_raw text;
  v_ttl int;
  v_expires timestamptz;
begin
  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status <> 'live' or not v_session.qr_enabled then
    raise exception 'qr_unavailable' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select * into v_inst from public.institutions where id = v_session.institution_id;
  v_ttl := coalesce(v_inst.qr_token_ttl_seconds, 4);
  v_raw := encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(24), 'hex');   -- 192 bits of entropy
  v_expires := now() + make_interval(secs => v_ttl);

  insert into public.qr_tokens (institution_id, session_id, token_hash, issued_by, expires_at)
  values (v_session.institution_id, p_session_id,
          encode(extensions.sha256(convert_to(v_raw, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), auth.uid(), v_expires);

  delete from public.qr_tokens
   where session_id = p_session_id and expires_at < now() - interval '5 minutes';

  return query select v_raw, v_expires;
end $$;

create or replace function public.rpc_check_in(p_token text)
returns table (attendance_id uuid, status public.attendance_status, checked_in_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_token public.qr_tokens;
  v_session public.sessions;
  v_inst public.institutions;
  v_student public.students;
  v_status public.attendance_status;
  v_late int;
  v_attendance_id uuid;
begin
  if p_token is null or length(p_token) < 16 then
    raise exception 'invalid_or_expired_token' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  if public.current_app_role() is distinct from 'student' then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select * into v_token
  from public.qr_tokens
  where token_hash = encode(extensions.sha256(convert_to(p_token, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
    and expires_at > v_now
  order by created_at desc
  for update skip locked;

  if not found then raise exception 'invalid_or_expired_token' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;

  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = v_token.session_id;
  if v_session.status <> 'live' or not v_session.qr_enabled then
    raise exception 'checkin_closed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select * into v_inst from public.institutions where id = v_session.institution_id;
  if v_now < v_session.starts_at - make_interval(mins => v_inst.checkin_opens_minutes_before)
     or v_now > v_session.starts_at + make_interval(mins => v_inst.checkin_closes_minutes_after) then
    raise exception 'checkin_window_closed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select st.* into v_student
  from public.students st
  join public.enrollments e on e.student_id = st.id
  where st.profile_id = auth.uid()
    and e.class_id = v_session.class_id
    and e.status = 'active'
    and e.deleted_at is null
    and st.deleted_at is null;

  if not found then raise exception 'not_enrolled' using errcode = '42501'; end if;

  if exists (
    select 1 from public.attendance
    where session_id = v_session.id and student_id = v_student.id
  ) then
    raise exception 'already_checked_in' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  -- One token may serve a whole room, but a student cannot replay it.
  begin
    insert into public.qr_token_uses (institution_id, token_id, student_id)
    values (v_student.institution_id, v_token.id, v_student.id);
  exception when unique_violation then
    raise exception 'token_already_used' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end;

  if v_now <= v_session.starts_at + make_interval(mins => v_inst.late_after_minutes) then
    v_status := 'present';
    v_late := null;
  else
    v_status := 'late';
    v_late := greatest(1, ceil(extract(epoch from (v_now - v_session.starts_at)) / 60)::int);
  end if;

  insert into public.attendance
    (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, late_minutes, source, marked_by, marked_at)
  values
    (v_session.institution_id, v_session.id, v_student.id, v_status, v_late, 'qr', auth.uid(), v_now)
  returning id into v_attendance_id;

  return query select v_attendance_id, v_status, v_now;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Teacher attendance save / administrator correction
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_save_attendance(p_session_id uuid, p_rows jsonb)
returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_session public.sessions;
  v_inst public.institutions;
  r record;
  v_row jsonb;
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_status public.attendance_status;
  v_late int;
  v_count int := 0;
begin
  if not (public.is_admin() or public.is_teacher()) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_rows), '') <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'rows_must_be_array' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status not in ('live', 'completed') then
    raise exception 'session_not_open_for_attendance' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select * into v_inst from public.institutions where id = v_session.institution_id;
  if not public.is_admin()
     and now() > v_session.ends_at + make_interval(hours => v_inst.attendance_edit_hours) then
    raise exception 'edit_window_closed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  for r in select value as row_data from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  loop
    v_row := r.row_data;
    v_student_id := (v_row ->> 'student_id')::uuid;
    v_status := (v_row ->> 'status')::public.attendance_status;
    v_late := nullif(v_row ->> 'late_minutes', '')::int;

    if not exists (
      select 1 from public.enrollments e
      where e.class_id = v_session.class_id
        and e.student_id = v_student_id
        and e.status = 'active'
        and e.deleted_at is null
    ) then
      raise exception 'student_not_enrolled' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    insert into public.attendance
      (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, late_minutes, notes,
       justification_reason, justification_url, source, marked_by, marked_at)
    values
      (v_session.institution_id, p_session_id, v_student_id, v_status, v_late,
       nullif(v_row ->> 'notes', ''),
       nullif(v_row ->> 'justification_reason', ''),
       nullif(v_row ->> 'justification_url', ''),
       'teacher', auth.uid(), now())
    on conflict (session_id, student_id) do update
       set status = excluded.status,
           late_minutes = excluded.late_minutes,
           notes = excluded.notes,
           justification_reason = excluded.justification_reason,
           justification_url = excluded.justification_url,
           source = 'teacher',
           marked_by = excluded.marked_by,
           marked_at = excluded.marked_at,
           updated_at = now();

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'attendance.bulk_save', 'session', p_session_id,
          jsonb_build_object('rows', v_count));

  return v_count;
end $$;

         notes = excluded.notes,
         justification_reason = excluded.justification_reason,
         justification_url = excluded.justification_url,

         marked_by = excluded.marked_by,

  values
    (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'attendance.admin_correction', 'attendance',
     v_attendance_id, v_before,
     jsonb_build_object('session_id', p_session_id, 'student_id', p_student_id,
                        'status', p_status, 'reason', p_reason));

  return v_attendance_id;
end $$;

-- rate = (present + 0.5 * late) / (present + late + absent); justified excluded.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------

  p_present int, p_late int, p_absent int
) returns numeric

returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$

  if not exists (
    select 1 from public.profiles p
    where p.id = new.teacher_id
      and p.institution_id = new.institution_id
      and p.role = 'teacher'
      and p.deleted_at is null

    raise exception 'teacher_private_details_owner_invalid' using errcode = '23514';
  end if;

-- A session's teacher must be the owner of the module being taught.
create or replace function public.fn_validate_session_teacher()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_module_owner uuid;
begin
  if new.class_module_id is not null then
    select m.owner_teacher_id into v_module_owner
    from public.class_modules cm
    join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
    where cm.id = new.class_module_id;

    if v_module_owner is distinct from new.teacher_id then
      raise exception 'session_teacher_must_match_module_owner' using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

  before insert or update of teacher_id, class_module_id on public.sessions
  for each row execute function public.fn_validate_session_teacher();

-- No attendance on cancelled / rescheduled occurrences (defence in depth).
create or replace function public.fn_block_attendance_on_inactive_session()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_status public.session_status;
begin
  select status into v_status from public.sessions where id = new.session_id;
  if v_status in ('cancelled', 'rescheduled') then
    raise exception 'attendance_not_allowed_on_%_session', v_status using errcode = '23514';
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

  before insert or update of session_id on public.attendance
  for each row execute function public.fn_block_attendance_on_inactive_session();

-- Keep the denormalised risk flag current for dashboards/alerts.
create or replace function public.fn_refresh_student_risk(p_student_id uuid)
returns void language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_inst uuid;
  v_warn numeric;
  v_crit numeric;
  v_rate numeric;
begin
  select institution_id into v_inst from public.students where id = p_student_id;
  if v_inst is null then return; end if;

  select risk_warning_pct, risk_critical_pct into v_warn, v_crit
  from public.institutions where id = v_inst;

  select public.attendance_rate(
    count(*) filter (where a.status = 'present')::int,
    count(*) filter (where a.status = 'late')::int,
    count(*) filter (where a.status = 'absent')::int
  ) into v_rate
  from public.attendance a
  join public.sessions s on s.id = a.session_id and s.status = 'completed'
  where a.student_id = p_student_id;

  update public.students
     set risk_level = case
       when v_rate is null then 'healthy'
       when v_rate < v_crit then 'critical'
       when v_rate < v_warn then 'at_risk'
       when v_rate < v_warn + 8 then 'watch'
       else 'healthy'
     end
   where id = p_student_id;
end $$;

create or replace function public.fn_attendance_refresh_risk()
returns trigger language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
begin
  perform public.fn_refresh_student_risk(new.student_id);
  return new;
end $$;

create trigger trg_attendance_refresh_risk
  after insert or update of status on public.attendance
  for each row execute function public.fn_attendance_refresh_risk();

    count(a.id) filter (where a.status = 'late')::int as late_count,

  from public.classes c

  join public.attendance a on a.session_id = s.id
  group by c.teacher_id

  p.first_name,
  p.last_name,
  p.email,
  p.title,
  d.name as department,
  (select count(*)::int from public.classes c

     from public.classes c
     join public.enrollments e on e.class_id = c.id

create or replace function public.current_institution_id()

  select p.role
  from public.profiles p

$$;

-- Bootstrap-friendly: service role key and local migration role are admins.
-- Normal JWT users are never treated as admins unless their profile says so.
create or replace function public.is_admin()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select auth.role() = 'service_role'
      or session_user in ('postgres', 'supabase_admin')
      or coalesce((
        select p.role = 'admin'
        from public.profiles p
        where p.id = auth.uid() and p.deleted_at is null
      ), false)
$$;

create or replace function public.is_teacher()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select coalesce(public.current_app_role() = 'teacher', false)
$$;

create or replace function public.is_student()
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select coalesce(public.current_app_role() = 'student', false)
$$;

create or replace function public.can_manage_class(p_class_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
      and c.deleted_at is null
      and (public.is_admin() or c.teacher_id = auth.uid())
  )
$$;

-- Full class access includes: owner, admin, module teacher, enrolled student.
create or replace function public.can_view_class(p_class_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.classes c
    where c.id = p_class_id
      and c.deleted_at is null
      and (
        public.is_admin()
        or c.teacher_id = auth.uid()
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.class_modules cm
          join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
          where cm.class_id = c.id
            and m.owner_teacher_id = auth.uid()
            and m.deleted_at is null
        )
        or exists (
          select 1 from public.enrollments e
          join public.students st on st.id = e.student_id
          where e.class_id = c.id
            and st.profile_id = auth.uid()
            and e.status = 'active'
            and e.deleted_at is null
            and st.deleted_at is null
        )
      )
  )
$$;

create or replace function public.owns_module(p_module_id uuid)
returns boolean language sql stable security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
  select exists (
    select 1 from public.modules m

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Weekly timetable -> concrete session occurrences
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_generate_sessions(
  p_class_id uuid,
  p_from date,
  p_to date,
  p_replace_future boolean default false
) returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_count int := 0;
begin
  if not (
    public.is_admin()
    or public.can_manage_class(p_class_id)
    or exists (
      select 1 from public.schedule_rules sr
      join public.class_modules cm on cm.id = sr.class_module_id
      join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
      where sr.class_id = p_class_id and m.owner_teacher_id = auth.uid()
    )
  ) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  if p_from is null or p_to is null or p_to < p_from then
    raise exception 'invalid_date_range' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  -- Timetable edits may rebuild future, untouched occurrences only.
  if p_replace_future then
    delete from public.sessions s
     where s.class_id = p_class_id
       and s.starts_at > now()
       and s.status = 'scheduled'
       and s.schedule_rule_id is not null;
  end if;

  with slots as (
    select
      sr.id as rule_id,
      sr.institution_id,
      sr.class_id,
      sr.class_module_id,
      m.owner_teacher_id,
      (greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from) + g.n) as day,
      sr.starts_at_time,
      sr.ends_at_time,
      sr.room,
      i.timezone
    from public.schedule_rules sr
    join public.class_modules cm on cm.id = sr.class_module_id
    join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
    join public.institutions i on i.id = sr.institution_id
    cross join lateral generate_series(
      0,
      least(sr.valid_until, p_to) - greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from)
    ) as g(n)
    where sr.class_id = p_class_id
      and sr.is_active
      and extract(isodow from (greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from) + g.n)) = sr.weekday
      and not exists (
        select 1 from public.holidays h
        where h.institution_id = sr.institution_id
          and h.holiday_date = (greatest(sr.valid_from, p_from) + g.n)
      )
  )
  insert into public.sessions
    (institution_id, class_id, class_module_id, schedule_rule_id, teacher_id,
     starts_at, ends_at, room, status, created_by)
  select
    institution_id, class_id, class_module_id, rule_id, owner_teacher_id,
    (day + starts_at_time) at time zone timezone,
    (day + ends_at_time) at time zone timezone,
    room, 'scheduled', auth.uid()
  from slots
  on conflict (schedule_rule_id, starts_at) do nothing;

  get diagnostics v_count = row_count;
  return v_count;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Session lifecycle
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_start_session(p_session_id uuid)
returns public.sessions
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_session public.sessions;
begin
  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status <> 'scheduled' then raise exception 'invalid_session_state' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;

  update public.sessions
     set status = 'live', opened_at = coalesce(opened_at, now()), updated_at = now()
   where id = p_session_id
  returning * into v_session;

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'session.start', 'session', v_session.id,
          jsonb_build_object('status', 'live', 'opened_at', v_session.opened_at));
  return v_session;
end $$;

create or replace function public.rpc_close_session(p_session_id uuid)
returns public.sessions
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_session public.sessions;
begin
  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status <> 'live' then raise exception 'invalid_session_state' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;

  update public.sessions
     set status = 'completed', closed_at = now(), qr_enabled = false, updated_at = now()
   where id = p_session_id
  returning * into v_session;

  -- Unmarked students become absent. Justified/manual records are preserved.
  -- Status is set first so the risk refresh trigger sees a completed session.
  insert into public.attendance
    (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, source, marked_by)
  select v_session.institution_id, v_session.id, e.student_id, 'absent', 'auto', auth.uid()
  from public.enrollments e
  where e.class_id = v_session.class_id
    and e.status = 'active'
    and e.deleted_at is null
  on conflict (session_id, student_id) do nothing;

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'session.close', 'session', v_session.id,
          jsonb_build_object('status', 'completed', 'closed_at', v_session.closed_at));
  return v_session;
end $$;

create or replace function public.rpc_change_session(
  p_session_id uuid,
  p_change public.change_type,
  p_reason text,
  p_new_start timestamptz default null,
  p_new_end timestamptz default null,
  p_new_room text default null
) returns public.sessions
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_old public.sessions;
  v_new public.sessions;
begin
  if p_reason is null or btrim(p_reason) = '' then
    raise exception 'reason_required' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select * into v_old from public.sessions where id = p_session_id for update;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_old.status in ('completed', 'cancelled', 'rescheduled') then
    raise exception 'session_locked' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  if p_change = 'cancelled' then
    update public.sessions
       set status = 'cancelled', cancel_reason = p_reason, qr_enabled = false, updated_at = now()
     where id = p_session_id
    returning * into v_new;
  else
    if p_new_start is null or p_new_end is null or p_new_end <= p_new_start then
      raise exception 'invalid_new_time' using errcode = '22023';
    end if;

    -- Replacement is deliberately NOT tied to a weekly rule: it is a one-off.
    insert into public.sessions
      (institution_id, class_id, class_module_id, teacher_id, starts_at, ends_at,
       room, status, created_by)
    values
      (v_old.institution_id, v_old.class_id, v_old.class_module_id, v_old.teacher_id,
       p_new_start, p_new_end, coalesce(p_new_room, v_old.room), 'scheduled', auth.uid())
    returning * into v_new;

    update public.sessions
       set status = 'rescheduled', rescheduled_to = v_new.id, cancel_reason = p_reason,
           qr_enabled = false, updated_at = now()
     where id = p_session_id;
  end if;

  insert into public.session_changes
    (institution_id, session_id, change, reason, previous, new_values, changed_by)
  values
    (v_old.institution_id, p_session_id, p_change, p_reason,
     jsonb_build_object('starts_at', v_old.starts_at, 'ends_at', v_old.ends_at, 'room', v_old.room),
     jsonb_build_object('new_session_id', v_new.id, 'starts_at', p_new_start,
                        'ends_at', p_new_end, 'room', coalesce(p_new_room, v_old.room)),
     auth.uid());

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_old.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'session.' || p_change::text, 'session', p_session_id,
          jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason, 'new_session_id', v_new.id));

  return v_new;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- QR tokens: 4-second lifetime, hash at rest, no client read access.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_issue_qr_token(p_session_id uuid)
returns table (token text, expires_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_session public.sessions;
  v_inst public.institutions;
  v_raw text;
  v_ttl int;
  v_expires timestamptz;
begin
  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status <> 'live' or not v_session.qr_enabled then
    raise exception 'qr_unavailable' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select * into v_inst from public.institutions where id = v_session.institution_id;
  v_ttl := coalesce(v_inst.qr_token_ttl_seconds, 4);
  v_raw := encode(extensions.gen_random_bytes(24), 'hex');   -- 192 bits of entropy
  v_expires := now() + make_interval(secs => v_ttl);

  insert into public.qr_tokens (institution_id, session_id, token_hash, issued_by, expires_at)
  values (v_session.institution_id, p_session_id,
          encode(extensions.sha256(convert_to(v_raw, 'UTF8')), 'hex'), auth.uid(), v_expires);

  delete from public.qr_tokens
   where session_id = p_session_id and expires_at < now() - interval '5 minutes';

  return query select v_raw, v_expires;
end $$;

create or replace function public.rpc_check_in(p_token text)
returns table (attendance_id uuid, status public.attendance_status, checked_in_at timestamptz)
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_now timestamptz := now();
  v_token public.qr_tokens;
  v_session public.sessions;
  v_inst public.institutions;
  v_student public.students;
  v_status public.attendance_status;
  v_late int;
  v_attendance_id uuid;
begin
  if p_token is null or length(p_token) < 16 then
    raise exception 'invalid_or_expired_token' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;
  if public.current_app_role() is distinct from 'student' then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;

  select * into v_token
  from public.qr_tokens
  where token_hash = encode(extensions.sha256(convert_to(p_token, 'UTF8')), 'hex')
    and expires_at > v_now
  order by created_at desc
  for update skip locked;

  if not found then raise exception 'invalid_or_expired_token' using errcode = 'P0001'; end if;

  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = v_token.session_id;
  if v_session.status <> 'live' or not v_session.qr_enabled then
    raise exception 'checkin_closed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select * into v_inst from public.institutions where id = v_session.institution_id;
  if v_now < v_session.starts_at - make_interval(mins => v_inst.checkin_opens_minutes_before)
     or v_now > v_session.starts_at + make_interval(mins => v_inst.checkin_closes_minutes_after) then
    raise exception 'checkin_window_closed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select st.* into v_student
  from public.students st
  join public.enrollments e on e.student_id = st.id
  where st.profile_id = auth.uid()
    and e.class_id = v_session.class_id
    and e.status = 'active'
    and e.deleted_at is null
    and st.deleted_at is null;

  if not found then raise exception 'not_enrolled' using errcode = '42501'; end if;

  if exists (
    select 1 from public.attendance
    where session_id = v_session.id and student_id = v_student.id
  ) then
    raise exception 'already_checked_in' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  -- One token may serve a whole room, but a student cannot replay it.
  begin
    insert into public.qr_token_uses (institution_id, token_id, student_id)
    values (v_student.institution_id, v_token.id, v_student.id);
  exception when unique_violation then
    raise exception 'token_already_used' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end;

  if v_now <= v_session.starts_at + make_interval(mins => v_inst.late_after_minutes) then
    v_status := 'present';
    v_late := null;
  else
    v_status := 'late';
    v_late := greatest(1, ceil(extract(epoch from (v_now - v_session.starts_at)) / 60)::int);
  end if;

  insert into public.attendance
    (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, late_minutes, source, marked_by, marked_at)
  values
    (v_session.institution_id, v_session.id, v_student.id, v_status, v_late, 'qr', auth.uid(), v_now)
  returning id into v_attendance_id;

  return query select v_attendance_id, v_status, v_now;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Teacher attendance save / administrator correction
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.rpc_save_attendance(p_session_id uuid, p_rows jsonb)
returns int
language plpgsql security definer set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare
  v_session public.sessions;
  v_inst public.institutions;
  r record;
  v_row jsonb;
  v_student_id uuid;
  v_status public.attendance_status;
  v_late int;
  v_count int := 0;
begin
  if not (public.is_admin() or public.is_teacher()) then
    raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501';
  end if;
  if coalesce(jsonb_typeof(p_rows), '') <> 'array' then
    raise exception 'rows_must_be_array' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;

  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id;
  if not found then raise exception 'session_not_found' using errcode = 'P0002'; end if;
  if not public.can_manage_session(p_session_id) then raise exception 'forbidden' using errcode = '42501'; end if;
  if v_session.status not in ('live', 'completed') then
    raise exception 'session_not_open_for_attendance' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  select * into v_inst from public.institutions where id = v_session.institution_id;
  if not public.is_admin()
     and now() > v_session.ends_at + make_interval(hours => v_inst.attendance_edit_hours) then
    raise exception 'edit_window_closed' using errcode = 'P0001';
  end if;

  for r in select value as row_data from jsonb_array_elements(p_rows)
  loop
    v_row := r.row_data;
    v_student_id := (v_row ->> 'student_id')::uuid;
    v_status := (v_row ->> 'status')::public.attendance_status;
    v_late := nullif(v_row ->> 'late_minutes', '')::int;

    if not exists (
      select 1 from public.enrollments e
      where e.class_id = v_session.class_id
        and e.student_id = v_student_id
        and e.status = 'active'
        and e.deleted_at is null
    ) then
      raise exception 'student_not_enrolled' using errcode = '42501';
    end if;

    insert into public.attendance
      (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, late_minutes, notes,
       justification_reason, justification_url, source, marked_by, marked_at)
    values
      (v_session.institution_id, p_session_id, v_student_id, v_status, v_late,
       nullif(v_row ->> 'notes', ''),
       nullif(v_row ->> 'justification_reason', ''),
       nullif(v_row ->> 'justification_url', ''),
       'teacher', auth.uid(), now())
    on conflict (session_id, student_id) do update
       set status = excluded.status,
           late_minutes = excluded.late_minutes,
           notes = excluded.notes,
           justification_reason = excluded.justification_reason,
           justification_url = excluded.justification_url,
           source = 'teacher',
           marked_by = excluded.marked_by,
           marked_at = excluded.marked_at,
           updated_at = now();

    v_count := v_count + 1;
  end loop;

  insert into public.audit_logs (institution_id, actor_id, action, entity_type, entity_id, after_data)
  values (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'attendance.bulk_save', 'session', p_session_id,
          jsonb_build_object('rows', v_count));

  return v_count;
end $$;

  p_reason text default null,

begin

  if p_reason is null or btrim(p_reason) = '' then
    raise exception 'correction_reason_required' using errcode = '22023';

  select * into v_session from public.sessions where id = p_session_id;

      and e.student_id = p_student_id
      and e.deleted_at is null
  ) then

  select to_jsonb(a) into v_before

  where a.session_id = p_session_id and a.student_id = p_student_id;

  insert into public.attendance
    (institution_id, session_id, student_id, status, late_minutes, notes,

  on conflict (session_id, student_id) do update
     set status = excluded.status,
         late_minutes = excluded.late_minutes,
         notes = excluded.notes,
         justification_reason = excluded.justification_reason,
         justification_url = excluded.justification_url,
         source = 'admin_correction',
         marked_by = excluded.marked_by,

         updated_at = now()
  returning id into v_attendance_id;

  insert into public.audit_logs

  values
    (v_session.institution_id, auth.uid(), 'attendance.admin_correction', 'attendance',
     v_attendance_id, v_before,
     jsonb_build_object('session_id', p_session_id, 'student_id', p_student_id,
                        'status', p_status, 'reason', p_reason));

  return v_attendance_id;
end $$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Function privileges: helpers + RPCs only; trigger functions stay internal.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
do $$
declare r record;
begin
  for r in
    select p.oid::regprocedure as sig
    from pg_proc p
    where p.pronamespace = 'public'::regnamespace
      and p.proname = any (array[
        'attendance_rate', 'current_institution_id', 'current_app_role',
        'is_admin', 'is_teacher', 'is_student', 'can_manage_class', 'can_view_class',
        'owns_module', 'can_view_module', 'teacher_owns_student',
        'can_manage_schedule_rule', 'can_manage_session', 'can_view_session',
        'rpc_generate_sessions', 'rpc_current_session', 'rpc_start_session',
        'rpc_close_session', 'rpc_change_session', 'rpc_issue_qr_token',
        'rpc_check_in', 'rpc_save_attendance', 'rpc_admin_correct_attendance'
      ])
  loop
    execute format('revoke all on function %s from public, anon', r.sig);
    execute format('grant execute on function %s to authenticated, service_role', r.sig);

statement: -- ============================================================================
-- ClassTrack · 0001 Core relational schema
-- Target: Supabase Postgres 15+
-- Scope: institutions, people, modules/classes, weekly schedules, sessions,
--        attendance, QR tokens, audit/history, reporting views.

set local search_path = public, extensions;

create schema if not exists extensions;
create extension if not exists pgcrypto with schema extensions;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Enums
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create type public.profile_status    as enum ('invited', 'active', 'suspended');
create type public.attendance_status as enum ('present', 'late', 'absent', 'justified');
create type public.attendance_source as enum ('qr', 'teacher', 'auto', 'admin_correction', 'import');
create type public.session_status    as enum ('scheduled', 'live', 'completed', 'cancelled', 'rescheduled');
create type public.change_type       as enum ('cancelled', 'rescheduled', 'time_changed', 'room_changed');
create type public.risk_level        as enum ('healthy', 'watch', 'at_risk', 'critical');
create type public.import_kind       as enum ('students_csv', 'students_xlsx', 'timetable_image', 'timetable_text');
create type public.import_status     as enum ('staged', 'review', 'committed', 'failed');
create type public.notification_kind as enum ('session', 'attendance', 'risk', 'import', 'report', 'invite', 'system');

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Pure domain helper: weighted attendance rate
-- rate = (present + 0.5 * late) / (present + late + absent); justified excluded.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create or replace function public.attendance_rate(
  p_present int, p_late int, p_absent int
) returns numeric
language sql immutable parallel safe
set search_path = public, pg_temp
as $$
  select case
    when coalesce(p_present, 0) + coalesce(p_late, 0) + coalesce(p_absent, 0) = 0 then null
    else round(
      (
        (coalesce(p_present, 0) + 0.5 * coalesce(p_late, 0))::numeric
        / (coalesce(p_present, 0) + coalesce(p_late, 0) + coalesce(p_absent, 0))::numeric
      ) * 100,
      2
    )
  end;
$$;

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Tenant root and academic calendar

create table public.institutions (
  id                          uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  name                        text not null,

  timezone                    text not null default 'Africa/Casablanca',
  -- Attendance windows (server-side authority; client clock is never trusted)
  checkin_opens_minutes_before int not null default 10  check (checkin_opens_minutes_before between 0 and 120),
  checkin_closes_minutes_after int not null default 15  check (checkin_closes_minutes_after between 1 and 240),
  late_after_minutes          int not null default 5    check (late_after_minutes between 0 and 240),
  -- QR policy. REQUIREMENT: temporary tokens live 4 seconds by default.
  qr_token_ttl_seconds        int not null default 4    check (qr_token_ttl_seconds between 1 and 60),
  attendance_edit_hours       int not null default 24   check (attendance_edit_hours between 0 and 720),

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Teaching model
-- MODULE  = subject owned by a teacher (what is taught).
-- CLASS   = cohort/group owned by a teacher (who is taught).
-- A student belongs to exactly one ACTIVE class (partial unique index below).
-- A teacher owns many modules and many classes; a module can be taught to
-- several classes; a class can receive several modules from different teachers.
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.modules (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id  uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  term_id         uuid not null,
  department_id   uuid references public.departments(id) on delete set null,
  owner_teacher_id uuid not null,
  code            text not null,
  title           text not null,
  description     text,
  color           text not null default '#2563EB',
  is_archived     boolean not null default false,
  deleted_at      timestamptz,
  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint modules_code_uq unique (institution_id, term_id, code),
  constraint modules_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint modules_term_fk foreign key (institution_id, term_id) references public.terms(institution_id, id) on delete restrict,
  constraint modules_owner_fk foreign key (institution_id, owner_teacher_id) references public.profiles(institution_id, id) on delete restrict
);
create index modules_owner_idx on public.modules (owner_teacher_id) where deleted_at is null;

create table public.classes (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),

  title             text not null,
  description       text,
  room              text,

  is_archived       boolean not null default false,
  deleted_at        timestamptz,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint classes_code_uq unique (institution_id, term_id, code),
  constraint classes_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint classes_term_fk foreign key (institution_id, term_id) references public.terms(institution_id, id) on delete restrict,
  constraint classes_teacher_fk foreign key (institution_id, teacher_id) references public.profiles(institution_id, id) on delete restrict

-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
-- Weekly recurrence rules -> generated session occurrences
-- ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
create table public.schedule_rules (
  id              uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id  uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  class_id        uuid not null,
  class_module_id uuid not null,
  weekday         smallint not null check (weekday between 1 and 7),  -- ISO: 1=Mon
  starts_at_time  time not null,
  ends_at_time    time not null,
  room            text,
  valid_from      date not null,
  valid_until     date not null,
  is_active       boolean not null default true,

  created_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at      timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint schedule_rules_time_valid check (ends_at_time > starts_at_time),
  constraint schedule_rules_window_valid check (valid_until >= valid_from),
  constraint schedule_rules_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  constraint schedule_rules_class_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_id) references public.classes(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint schedule_rules_class_module_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_module_id) references public.class_modules(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  -- Guarantees the rule points at a module actually attached to its class.
  constraint schedule_rules_class_module_match_fk
    foreign key (class_module_id, class_id) references public.class_modules(id, class_id) on delete cascade
);
create index schedule_rules_lookup_idx on public.schedule_rules (class_id, weekday) where is_active;
create index schedule_rules_module_idx on public.schedule_rules (class_module_id);

create table public.sessions (
  id                uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  institution_id    uuid not null references public.institutions(id) on delete cascade,
  class_id          uuid not null,
  class_module_id   uuid,                       -- null = ad-hoc session
  schedule_rule_id  uuid,                       -- null = ad-hoc / replacement
  teacher_id        uuid not null,               -- teacher who actually teaches it
  starts_at         timestamptz not null,
  ends_at           timestamptz not null,
  room              text,
  status            public.session_status not null default 'scheduled',
  qr_enabled        boolean not null default true,
  opened_at         timestamptz,
  closed_at         timestamptz,
  cancel_reason     text,
  rescheduled_to    uuid references public.sessions(id) on delete set null,
  notes             text,
  created_by        uuid references public.profiles(id) on delete set null,
  created_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at        timestamptz not null default now(),
  constraint sessions_time_valid check (ends_at > starts_at),
  constraint sessions_cancel_reason check (status <> 'cancelled' or cancel_reason is not null),
  constraint sessions_institution_id_uq unique (institution_id, id),
  -- One occurrence per weekly rule slot: regeneration is idempotent.
  constraint sessions_generated_uq unique (schedule_rule_id, starts_at),
  constraint sessions_class_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_id) references public.classes(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,
  constraint sessions_class_module_fk foreign key (institution_id, class_module_id) references public.class_modules(institution_id, id) on delete cascade,

-- A session's teacher must be the owner of the module being taught.
create or replace function public.fn_validate_session_teacher()
returns trigger language plpgsql set search_path = public, pg_temp as $$
declare v_module_owner uuid;
begin
  if new.class_module_id is not null then
    select m.owner_teacher_id into v_module_owner
    from public.class_modules cm
    join public.modules m on m.id = cm.module_id
    where cm.id = new.class_module_id;

    if v_module_owner is distinct from new.teacher_id then
      raise exception 'session_teacher_must_match_module_owner' using errcode = '23514';
    end if;
  end if;
  return new;
end $$;

  for each row execute function public.fn_validate_session_teacher();

  if v_status in ('cancelled', 'rescheduled') then
    raise exception 'attendance_not_allowed_on_%_session', v_status using errcode = '23514';

end $$;
